description: A DRY-RUN config for the local laboratory. It mirrors what .github/dependabot.yml already does, so the two can be compared on the same repo rather than on different rules.

packageRules.description: Patch and minor together — twelve separate PRs for patch bumps is how a bot becomes noise nobody reads.
Never the JDK. CI pins Temurin 21 deliberately and a bump here would silently make the local gate a different gate.
The CI laboratory's own images update on their own schedule — they are not the product.
